name: Ski and snowboard instructor

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Erik and Sofia (instructors at the ski school)

services.name: ski lesson (5-lesson pack)
services.story: The main story: Alex buys a 5-lesson pack, $275 ($55 a lesson), and the first 60-minute lesson with Erik uses one. A no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services.name: ski lesson
services.story: A single 30-minute lesson, $35. A card is saved for the ski school's $20 fee, and Alex pays at the desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Marco and Ines (instructors who travel to the lodge)

services.name: 60-minute lesson at the lodge
services.story: The main story: a $179 60-minute lesson at Alex's lodge with Marco. A card is saved and charged $179 when Marco texts DONE.

services.name: Lesson at the lodge (3-lesson pack)
services.story: A 3-lesson pack at the lodge, $450 ($150 a lesson), paid in full when booking. Each lesson uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: one person's time: a lesson with a named instructor, booked by the instructor's free hours, at the ski school meeting point, at the client's lodge, or at a meeting spot the business lists; a partner lesson adds a second person
questions_before_times: new or returning (a new student gets the level check first, and the waiver)
what to work on: first turns, stopping, a steeper run, or a snowboard
where: the ski school, at the lodge, or at a meeting spot on the mountain
a single lesson, a pack or a weekly plan
one person or two (a partner lesson)
safety_stop: someone hurt on the hill right now: a fall with a hit to the head, not waking up, bleeding badly, or not breathing
an avalanche, a whiteout, or someone lost in the snow right now
someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or sudden weakness
license: none checked by Rosie: ski and snowboard lessons need no state license here; a license or insurance is optional and the business's own word (D96)
staff_skills: first turns, stopping, steeper runs, snowboard basics, and kids; kids only with instructors the owner clears for them
messages_never: health answers, injuries, a doctor's note and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the student's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
